impact.intro: Required tier is the highest that applies. Answer yes or no for each statement.
impact.I1: Outputs reach affected people directly (messages, answers or translations they read or hear)
impact.I2: Outputs influence who receives assistance, services or protection, or in what priority
impact.I3: Outputs shape operational decisions while a person decides
impact.I4: Internal and advisory only; a person reviews every output before use
impact.incomplete: Answer yes or no to every impact question before a tier is shown.
impact.allNo: No tier applies because you answered no to every statement. If a person does not review every output before it is used, the use is not "internal and advisory" (I4). Reconsider whether I3 applies, or discuss this use with your organisation.
tier.label: Required tier
tier.1.name: Tier 1 (Baseline)
tier.1.quote: Internal, advisory AI use. Light-touch governance.
tier.2.name: Tier 2 (Enhanced)
tier.2.quote: AI shapes operational decisions, with human oversight. Full assessment and assurance required.
tier.3.name: Tier 3 (High risk)
tier.3.quote: AI directly affects people's access to assistance, protection, or information. Community co-design and ongoing monitoring are mandatory.
tier.attribution: SAFE AI v1.2 (CDAC Network, The Alan Turing Institute and Humanitarian AI Advisory, August 2026), licensed CC BY 4.0
data.intro: Which data types apply to this use?
data.D2: Sensitive categories (health, protection, GBV, legal status, ethnicity, religion, biometrics, precise location of people at risk)
rules.R1: Sensitive categories (D2) in a public consumer tool.
rules.R2: Outputs influence assistance or protection (I2) with no human review of each case.
rules.R3: Tier 3 use with no information for affected people and no complaints channel.
rules.R4: Data about children (D3) in a public consumer tool.
safeguards.intro: Check safeguards that are in place. Required safeguards depend on the tier.
safeguards.S_USER_TRAINING: Users trained on tool and limits
safeguards.S_DPIA: Data protection impact assessment (when D1–D4 apply)
safeguards.S_INFO_AFFECTED: Information for affected people (languages and accessible formats)
safeguards.S_COMPLAINTS_CHANNEL: Feedback and complaints channel with human response
safeguards.S_ERROR_MONITORING: Ongoing monitoring of errors and harms
safeguards.S_HUMAN_ALTERNATIVE: Way to get a human alternative
safeguards.S_HUMAN_REVIEW_EACH_CASE: Human review of each case (required when I2 applies)

method.decisionText: Red flags take precedence over missing safeguards. Missing required safeguards produce an amber decision. When no red flags fire and all required safeguards are in place, the decision is green.
